text:
alex_m: Quick sync — proposing we add a top-level `billable_units` integer to the /v1/usage response to simplify downstream billing. need to confirm how this interacts with cached tokens and streaming. @priya_k any objections?
priya_k: quick q — is `billable_units` derived server-side (recommended) or will SDKs compute it? also what about older clients that only read `prompt_tokens` / `completion_tokens`? :thinking_face: 
alex_m: plan is server-side. idea: keep `prompt_tokens` and `completion_tokens` for backcompat, but include `origin` for each token group and the new `billable_units` that already accounts for cache-hit adjustment and streaming partials. example response: ```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 42,
  "completion_tokens": 128,
  "token_breakdown": [
    {"kind": "prompt", "count": 42, "origin": "live"},
    {"kind": "completion", "count": 70, "origin": "live"},
    {"kind": "completion", "count": 58, "origin": "cached"}
  ],
  "billable_units": 112
}
```
alex_m: billable_units = live_prompt + live_completion only (so cached completions do not increment billable units). for streaming, billable_units should reflect final aggregated live tokens, not intermediate deltas.
jamie_r: sounds reasonable. small ask: please document the exact rule for prefix-cached completions where the client saw text but server served from cache — should origin be `cached` and count toward completion_tokens but not billable_units? 
priya_k: older SDKs will continue to read `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` and compute costs themselves, so we need a migration note: "if `billable_units` present, use it for invoicing; otherwise fall back to legacy fields."
daniel_b: edge-case: incremental streaming + fallback model change — if we start streaming from model A and then fallback to B mid-stream, how do we attribute? propose: always report per-commit chunk attribution in `token_breakdown` with an optional `model_variant` field, and `billable_units` is the sum of entries where `origin` == `live`. e.g. `token_breakdown` items can include `model_variant`: `a100-v1` etc.
alex_m: agree. we should also add a strict note: `billable_units` is authoritative for billing; never compute billing from token arrays if `billable_units` exists. prevents double-counting by clients.
priya_k: one more: telemetry/console needs to preserve delta semantics for streaming so dashboards don't flicker. frontend will use `billable_units` as final number, and display incremental estimates until finalization. add a `finalized` boolean in webhook events.
jamie_r: :+1: can eng-infra update the SDKs to expose `billable_units` on response objects and mark old helpers deprecated? this will help customers adopt quickly.
daniel_b: I'm going to add a tiny unit test in the runtime that simulates cached prefix + live remainder to assert `billable_units` equals live counts. will ping when PR is up.
billing-bot: Invoice event sample posted to #billing: `{"event":"usage_report", "billable_units":112, "currency_units":11200}` — note: currency conversion happens downstream. :white_check_mark: 
alex_m: thanks all — action items: (1) docs PR with migration guidance (priya), (2) SDK changes ticket (jamie), (3) runtime tests + PR (daniel). ping me if anything blocks. :shipit:
